meta.title: 蝶泳腿打不起来？两招带你掌握蝶泳腿
meta.title_en: Can't Get the Butterfly Kick? Two Steps to Master It

scenes.title_en: Press the Lower Legs, Then Lift the Body
scenes.context: 今天教蝶泳腿。先把小腿往下压，顺势将上半身上抬。蝶泳腿的关键是下压小腿后利用反作用力让上半身上抬。语域：游泳教学，动作口令。
sentences: 今天教你蝶泳腿，Ready?
Today I'll teach you the butterfly kick — ready?
butterfly kick（蝶泳腿）
先把小腿往下压，顺势将上半身上抬。
First press the lower legs down, then lift your upper body on the rebound.
on the rebound（顺势）
先重复几遍，找找感觉。
Repeat it a few times to get the feel.
get the feel（找感觉）
paraphrase: 往下压 → press down / push downward
顺势 → on the rebound / with the momentum
scenes.speak: Today I'll teach you the butterfly kick — ready? First press the lower legs down, then lift your upper body on the rebound. Repeat it a few times to get the feel.

scenes.title_cn: 用腿末段力量支撑全身
scenes.title_en: Support the Whole Body With the Tail of the Kick
scenes.context: 再逐步用腿末段的力量支撑起整个身体。重点是力量从腿末段发出，带动全身。语域：游泳教学，发力讲解。
sentences: 再逐步用腿末段的力量支撑起整个身体。
Then gradually use the tail-end power of your legs to support the whole body.
tail-end power（腿末段力量）
力量从腿末段发出，带动全身。
The power originates in the lower leg and drives your whole body.
originates in（源自）
最后连起来就行了。
Finally, just link it all together.
link it all together（连起来）
paraphrase: 腿末段 → tail-end of the leg / lower-leg tip
连起来 → link it together / chain the moves
scenes.speak: Then gradually use the tail-end power of your legs to support the whole body. The power originates in the lower leg and drives your whole body. Finally, just link it all together.

scenes.title_cn: 连起来练 + 轻松收尾
scenes.title_en: Chain the Moves and Wrapped Up
scenes.context: 两步连起来：下压小腿、上抬上身、腿末段发力。学会了吗？轻松的收尾互动。语域：游泳教学，收尾。
sentences: 两步连起来：下压、上抬、末段发力。
Chain the two steps: press, lift, and fire from the leg tip.
fire from the leg tip（末段发力）
先找感觉，再连起来，最后发力。
First feel it, then link it, then add the power.
add the power（发力）
学废了吗？
Did you get it?
get it（学会）
paraphrase: 连起来练 → chain the drills / put it together
学会了吗 → did you get it / got the hang of it
scenes.speak: Chain the two steps: press, lift, and fire from the leg tip. First feel it, then link it, then add the power. Did you get it?

practice: Press the lower legs down, then lift your upper body on the rebound.
Use the tail-end power of your legs to support the whole body.
Chain the two steps: press, lift, and fire from the leg tip.
First feel it, then link it, then add the power. Did you get it?
pitfalls: 「小腿」用 lower legs，不是 small legs。
Lift your upper body by the way.
Lift your upper body on the rebound.
「顺势」用 on the rebound / with the momentum。
Use the power of the end of leg.
Use the tail-end power of your legs.
「腿末段」用 tail-end of the leg。
「学废了吗」是网络梗，英文用 Did you get it。
shifts: 用 press the lower legs down（下压小腿）、tail-end power（末段发力）、on the rebound（顺势）
用 originates in（源自）、fire from（从…发力）、support the body（支撑身体）
用 get the feel（找感觉）、link it together（连起来）、chain（串联）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：跌泳→蝶泳、Ready、下压、顺势、上抬、腿末段、支撑、连起来、学废→学会等。
